Name: Clock select
Firmware use: per mode; set_video_mode writes $3C2 after ext 6, so the misc byte decides CSEL1-0

Name: CPU latch index
Firmware use: written by every mode record (bytes 75-80 write $30-$35)

Name: CPU latch data
Firmware use: never read or written by ROM 1.4 routines; host GetVGAReg can request it
